mapper.select: SELECT sku, sku_name, sku_type, spec, unit, remark, use_yn, tax_yn FROM tb_sku_master

SELECT sku.sku, -- 품목코드 sku.sku_name, -- 품목명 sku.spec, -- 규격 sku.unit, -- 단위 unit.unit_price_type, -- 단가유형 cmCode.code_name "type_name", -- 단가유형이름 unit.unit_price -- 단가 FROM tb_sku_master sku JOIN tb_unit_price_master unit ON sku.company_code = unit.company_code AND sku.sku = unit.sku JOIN tb_cm_code cmCode ON unit.unit_price_type = cmCode.code WHERE sku.sku_type = 'ITEM' AND unit.unit_price_type != 'BUY_UNIT' AND unit.cust_code = #{custCode}
AND unit_price_type = 'SELL_UNIT'
